snippet.title: Hey, Girlie! A Kristen Applebees Dating Sim - Voice Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the cast voicing the titular girlies! 🍎🐝

"Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim releasing on May 17 on itch.io. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel. This is a fan project unaffiliated with Dimension 20 or Dropout, developed with the hard work of 52 creatives!

VOICE CAST 🎙️
   Kristen Applebees / silkywishes (they/she) / Twitch/Tumblr/X/Bsky: @silkywishes
   Cassandra / MJ Chestang (she/her) / X/Bsky: @mjmagicish
   Gertie Bladeshield / TheSingingKoala (she/her) / X: @SailorIronKoala, Bsky: @thesingingkoala
   Kipperlilly Copperkettle / jaye (they/them) / X/IG: joyt_ea
   Lucy Frostblade / Alex Mirabal (they/them) / Bsky: @alexkmz, Twitch: @alexkmz316
   Tracker O'Shaughnessy / Julia Lee (she/her) / X/IG: @meimeigoesmoo, Bsky: @moomei 
   Naradriel / Rin (they/she) / X/Tumblr/Bsky: @confusedshethey
   Fig Faeth / Zoe D. Lee (she/her) / X: @ZotatoPotato, https://zoedlee.carrd.co

SPRITE ARTISTS 🖌️
   Kristen / Monomercy (she/they) / Tumblr: @m0nomercy, X/IG: @_monomercy_
   Cassandra / Maia Trewartha (any pronouns) / Tumblr: @emptyjunior, X: @empty_jr
   Gertie / Wyrmwright / X/IG/Tumblr/Bsky: @wyrmwright, https://wyrmwright.carrd.co
   Kipperlilly / Nexus (she/they) / X: @nexusnos, Tumblr/Bsky: @nosnexus
   Lucy / Issy (they/them) / X/Tumblr/Bsky: @thelongestwalk
   Tracker / Mado Chadebec (she/her) / IG: @machadebec, Tumblr: @cowgirls-blues 
   Naradriel / Em (they/she) / X/Tumblr: @glittersploots
   Fig / Lam (she/they) / X/IG: @soncerue

GYM BACKGROUND ARTISTS 🏀
   Render / Eren (they/them) / X/Tumblr: @chromathesia
   Lines / Diane (she/her) / X/IG/Tumblr: @dieantik
   Sketch / Julia Lee (she/her)

VIDEO EDITOR 🎞️
   @ZoeDLeeVA

OTHER VIDEO CREDITS ⭐
   Hey, Girlie! Logo and Visual Branding / Kelp (they/she) / X: @Kelparoni
   YouTube Thumbnail and Captioning / Radish (they/any)
   BGM / https://www.fesliyanstudios.com/

For the full project contributor list, see https://raddishradish.itch.io/hey-girlie. If you're interested in our updates, follow us on social media:
   X: https://www.x.com/heygirliegame/
   IG: https://www.instagram.com/heygirliegame/
   Tumblr: https://www.tumblr.com/heygirliegame/
   TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@heygirlie.game/

Hungry for more after the game releases? We will be releasing a bundle of bonus content, including cut dialogue, interviews/BTS content from our contributors, and more, for those who make a donation of any amount to any Palestinian campaign. More info at https://heygirliegame.carrd.co!
